subject: general
question: Who among the following personalities, known by the affectionate moniker 'Nightingale of Bollywood', passed away in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Legendary singer Lata Mangeshkar passed away on February 6 2022.
 
• She crooned songs in over a thousand Hindi films and has sung in over thirty-six Indian languages.
 
• Nicknamed 'The Nightingale of Bollywood', the singer was bestowed with India's highest civilian honour Bharat Ratna in 2001.
 
• She was also honoured with the Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan.​ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• Sarojini Naidu is known as The Nightingale of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
